props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value for the uncontrolled case.

props.name: description
props.description: Persistent helper text below the group.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction. Mirrors the ARIA name.

props.name: error
props.description: The validation message. Its presence drives `aria-invalid`.

props.name: form
props.description: Associates the control with a form it is not nested inside.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid, with the same independence from `error` as Input.

props.name: label
props.description: The group's own label text, rendered above the options.

props.name: name
props.description: The submitted name. Every radio in the group carries it.

props.name: options
props.description: The choices. Serialized as JSON when written as an attribute.

props.name: required
props.description: Native constraint validation still applies and is never suppressed.

props.name: size
props.description: Label text size. The row target stays 44px at every size.

props.name: value
props.description: The value. Uncontrolled by default; "" means nothing selected.

ai.summary: An exclusive choice from a small set of options, rendered as real native radios so the browser owns arrow-key navigation and validation.
whenToUse: Exactly one choice from 2–7 known options
The options are short enough to read at a glance — longer lists want a Select
It must submit through a plain `<form>` with no JavaScript state
whenNotToUse: More than roughly 7 options — use a Select, which scrolls and filters
Several choices at once — use a Checkbox per option
A single on/off setting that acts immediately — use a Switch
ai.accessibility: Renders real native `<input type="radio">` elements in a `role="radiogroup"` container, so the browser owns arrow-key navigation within the group, the single tab stop, and constraint validation ("please select one of these options" is the browser's message, not a reimplementation). The group label names the container through `aria-labelledby`; each option is labelled by its wrapping label. An error sets `aria-invalid` and renders an icon beside its text, never color alone (WCAG 1.4.1). Implements the FACE contract on the group: formResetCallback, formDisabledCallback, formStateRestoreCallback, and sk-value-change fires only for user-initiated changes.
knownLimitations: Options arrive as JSON, like Select — they cannot be slotted as children, because scoped encapsulation cannot distribute host children into the render tree
The generated `id` for the group label differs from React's `useId()`, so an SSR consumer must pass an explicit `id` (section 4, forms contract)
